title: W08b: read-only plugin backend endpoints
description: Implement the plugin's namespaced read backend over the Waystation snapshot, detail, thread and history CLI, with that transport combination fixed: accept registration keys only, invoke allowlisted read commands through argument arrays, supply the explicit root, enforce timeout and output bounds, validate the command result and return its data. No direct canonical file parsing, no arbitrary command proxy, no sync, no repair and no task mutation. Registry settings stay separate from data endpoints, so a task or thread request can never substitute its own path.
acceptance: Only allowlisted read commands are reachable, and no endpoint accepts a path, a command name or a ledger root from the caller.
A command failure, a timeout, an oversized output and a malformed result each produce a typed error instead of partial data.
The backend performs no canonical write and cannot mutate a task, and a corrupted or missing ledger returns an error rather than an empty board.
Backend enablement is checked separately from native enablement, and disabling the plugin leaves the ledger untouched and does not release claims.
notes:
Acceptance group A15 backend half. One package carries plugin.yaml, the dashboard backend and the native desktop half; plugin code may import only the desktop SDK and react.

Reconciliation finding: W08a is a TypeScript registry library behind PluginState. Implement the actual profile-scoped host bridge and cross-process read-modify-write lock; do not import TypeScript from Python or assume ctx.state is already wired. Keep the config lock out of MCP/ledger waits. W08d verifies this integration in the native host.
